about.title: About LaBelle
about.description: LaBelle is a growing community in Southwest Florida, perfect for families looking for a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to major cities. Our new construction homes in LaBelle offers spacious lots, exceptional value, and our innovative Rent to Own program with 5 years of rent stability..
about.fullDescription: The city of LaBelle is located in a region with calming outdoors and wildlife, immersed in oak trees that characterize its landscape and provide shade to its land. With these exceptional outdoors, you can enjoy activites such as fishing, offroading, hiking, boating and more. The city of LaBelle is the main urban conglomerate in the region today and preserves an important historical center with buildings constructed at the end of the 19th century and the beginning of the 20th century. LaBelle continues to contribute to the conservation of the rich architectural heritage in Florida. While cultivating its history, it proudly welcomes the urbanization of its developing areas.

about.title: About Lehigh Acres
about.description: Lehigh Acres is a growing community in Southwest Florida, offering affordable living in a great location. Our new construction homes in Lehigh Acres feature modern designs, spacious layouts, and our innovative Rent to Own program with 5 years of rent stability.
about.fullDescription: Lehigh Acres is a community where residents can enjoy freshwater fishing year-round, world-class golf courses, tennis, bicycling, nature trails, and numerous other activities at various clubs and organizations. As one of the fastest growing cities in the state of Florida, Lehigh Acres has nearly doubled in new home construction within the last 24 months. It is located only 15 minutes east of Cape Coral, 12 miles east of Fort Myers, and is equidistant to 3 major cities: Miami, Orlando and Tampa. Lehigh Acres offers beautiful lakes and is approximately 35 minutes away from a few of Florida's most breathtaking beaches, including Bonita Beach, Fort Myers Beach, and the Islands of Sanibel and Captiva.

whatIs.title: What is Rent to Own?
whatIs.description: Our Rent-to-Own Program is designed to turn your goal of homeownership into reality—without the common obstacles that hold buyers back. Credit challenges, down payment concerns, or closing costs do not have to stop you. With this program, you rent your future home at a fixed monthly rate, while automatically saving toward your down payment and closing costs, which are credited back to you at purchase. The home price is locked in from day one, eliminating surprises and rent increases, and you will receive professional guidance throughout the process, plus complimentary lawn care twice per month. It is a simple, secure, and smart path from renting to owning your dream home.
